title: de-Ferra2020-kz: A REMARK reproducing Household Heterogeneity and the Transmission of Foreign Shocks
description: REMARK (Replication and Exploration Made using ARK) for de Ferra, Mitman, and Romei (2020), 'Household heterogeneity and the transmission of foreign shocks', Journal of International Economics 124, 103303. Includes a LaTeX paper summarising the model and calibration, and a Python reproduction pipeline (notebooks 01–14) that replicates Table 1, Figures 1–5, and the full credit-supply expansion and unexpected-contraction transitions from scratch.
